g.text: Encode the video once: Cached and Joint inference
Cached inference: questions arrive one by one
one causal forward pass for all; each question
later questions can attend to earlier questions
and options, but no answers are inserted
Training uses the same layout: several questions per video share one prefix.
Generative baselines can reuse the video prefix too, but must still decode each answer token by token;
only single-token answers (a letter) can be read jointly.
